primitives.name: Root
primitives.definition: Operator-declared root or root-like structural region. Morphological label only; no semantic function implied.

primitives.name: Stem
primitives.definition: Operator-declared elongated connecting axis or stem-like structure. Morphological label only.

primitives.name: Y junction
primitives.definition: Operator-declared bifurcating Y-like junction or split. Geometric/morphological label only.

primitives.name: Dense field
primitives.definition: Operator-declared region with comparatively dense repeated marks, strokes, stems, or other visual elements. Requires an explicit density method before measurement claims.

primitives.name: Glyph cluster
primitives.definition: Operator-declared contiguous or relational group of manuscript glyphs. Cluster boundary and selection rule must be recorded.
